description: This file defines the class 'ReplicatedVertexView' which manages shipping and updating vertex attributes in edge partitions within Spark's GraphX component. It includes methods for reversing edges, upgrading shipping levels, setting active vertex sets, and updating vertex attributes.

classes.name: ReplicatedVertexView
classes.description: Manages shipping vertex attributes to edge partitions, allowing updates, reversals, and active set management within Spark's GraphX.

methods.name: withEdges
methods.description: Creates a new ReplicatedVertexView with a different EdgeRDD, maintaining the same shipping level.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Returns a new ReplicatedVertexView with edges reversed and source/destination IDs swapped.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the shipping level by shipping vertex attributes from 'vertices' to edge partitions, modifying the view in-place.

methods.name: withActiveSet
methods.description: Creates a new ReplicatedVertexView with an active set of vertices, shipping vertex IDs to relevant edge partitions.

methods.name: updateVertices
methods.description: Returns a new ReplicatedVertexView with vertex attributes updated in edge partitions based on 'updates'.
